drillName: PostgreSQL 16 Enterprise Database Disaster Recovery & Restore Verification
directiveCompliance: FDRE MoR Directive No. 1142/2026 Art. 5(4) & Art. 14(3)(a-g)
certificationRule: Rule 18 — High Availability and Disaster Recovery

procedure.action: Execute physical SQL backup using pg_dump
Provision clean isolated drill target database
Restore backup archive into drill database
Verify schema tables and objects post-restore
procedure.verificationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_class WHERE relrowsecurity = true

procedure.action: Verify Flyway schema migration history post-restore
procedure.verificationQuery: SELECT installed_rank, version, description, success FROM flyway_schema_history ORDER BY installed_rank

metrics.recoveryPointObjective: RPO = 0 (streaming WAL replication in production topology)

verdict: DESIGNED + TESTED IN LOCAL CONTAINERIZED STAGING ENVIRONMENT — PRODUCTION PHYSICAL FAILOVER PENDING LIVE DC DEPLOYMENT
